name: feathery
description: Work with Feathery forms, submissions, document extractions, data hubs, and meetings.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Feathery account to build and edit forms, search and export submissions, run AI document extractions and check their results, manage data hub entries, and read recorded meetings with their summaries, action items, and transcripts. Sign in with your Feathery account; ChatGPT can only reach what that account can see. Tools that change or delete data are labeled, and deletions require explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my meetings from last week
Show this week's completed submissions for a form

positive.prompt: What forms do I have in Feathery?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Client Onboarding form and shows that it is active.

positive.description: Walk through a form's steps and fields
positive.prompt: Walk me through the Client Onboarding form step by step. What does it ask for?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the form's three steps and their fields: Contact Details (first name, last name, email, phone), Company Details (company name, website, industry, company size, address) and Account Preferences (preferred contact method, how they heard about us, notes, terms agreement).

positive.description: Explain what a document extraction reads
positive.prompt: What information does the W-9 Extraction pull from a document, and where does it save it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the six values it reads from an IRS Form W-9 (name, business name, federal tax classification, address, city/state/ZIP and signature date), each saved to a matching w9_* hidden field.

positive.description: See who is on the team
positive.prompt: Who is on my Feathery team, and what are their roles?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the MCP Review organization and its one member, allen+mcpreview@feathery.io, with the Admin role.

positive.prompt: Add a hidden field called crm_id so we can store each client's CRM record ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the hidden field crm_id and confirms it. If an earlier run already created it, reports that it already exists and creates nothing.

negative.description: Deleting forms the user hasn't named. Deletion can't be undone, so the plugin must confirm the exact forms first.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which forms to delete and doesn't call delete_form until the user confirms specific forms.

negative.description: A request outside Feathery, which has no travel features.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to New York next Tuesday.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Feathery tools and says it can't book travel.

negative.description: Changing the billing plan, which the plugin has no tools for and shouldn't start from ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Feathery account to the Business plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Feathery tools and says plan changes are made in Feathery.

review.commerce_description: Feathery doesn't sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: forms, logic rules, submissions, users, hidden fields, AI document extractions, data hubs, logs, documentation search and meetings, with sign-in through your Feathery account.
